title: Sliding Hatch Drop
name: sliding_hatch_drop
description: A ball rests centered on a square hatch panel set flush into a raised platform, filling a hole. The hatch slides sideways fully clear of the hole, removing the support, so the ball free-falls straight down through the opening to the floor below, where it bounces and settles, with nothing left suspended.

video_split.event: panel left edge clears the hole; ball released into free fall
